items.prompt: Why does union by size limit depth growth?

options.text: Each depth increase at least doubles its set size
options.why: There are only logarithmically many such doublings before reaching n elements.

options.text: It guarantees every representative equals zero
options.why: The representative depends on merges and tie policy.

options.text: It prevents every future find from writing parents
It makes arbitrary edge deletion safe
options.why: Depth control does not add deletion support.

items.explanation: A size-doubling argument bounds depth; it does not establish stable representative identity or deletion capabilities.
